translations.web: So they, and all that belonged to them went down alive into Sheol. The earth closed on them, and they perished from among the assembly.
translations.bsb: They went down alive into Sheol with all they owned. The earth closed over them, and they vanished from the assembly.
translations.kjv: They, and all that appertained to them, went down alive into the pit, and the earth closed upon them: and they perished from among the congregation.
translations.asv: So they, and all that appertained to them, went down alive into Sheol: and the earth closed upon them, and they perished from among the assembly.
